title: ClearHorizons
description: ClearHorizons lets low-end PCs see what high-end rigs usually can’t.
body:
ClearHorizons lets low-end PCs see what high-end rigs usually can’t.
With **Distant Horizons** seamlessly extending your view far beyond Minecraft’s normal limits, you can enjoy vast landscapes and massive builds at render distances that feel like **128+** chunks — even if your base game only runs at 8 or 16.

But it’s not just about distance — it’s about smoothness.
Thanks to **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and other key optimizations, the game runs buttery-smooth even while pushing your view distance to the max. Add in **Blur+ **for those clean transitions and a sleek look, and you get a performance-friendly visual upgrade that feels premium.

Whether you’re exploring mountains, flying over megabases, or just want to actually see your world, ClearHorizons delivers clarity without the lag.
